subject.title: [Feature]: Fold the New session target controls into click menus

question: Should the compact menu design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105265 replace the current inline `/new` target controls?
rationale: The implementation direction is coherent and vision-aligned, but trading immediate visibility for a quieter one-line launcher is an intentional product interaction decision.

options.title: Adopt compact menus
options.body: Review and land the linked PR after confirming accessibility, mobile layout, and behavioral parity.

options.title: Retain inline controls
options.body: Keep the current compacted inline row if immediate visibility of target settings is more important than reducing vertical space.

recommendation.title: Adopt compact menus
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR after confirming accessibility, mobile layout, and behavioral parity.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows this person introduced and recently maintained the exact new-session and sibling menu surfaces involved.
